alex: Quick QBR prep — need final partner scorecard slices + MDF asks by EOD today. We'll present at Thu QBR. Can folks confirm status for marketplace, HW partners, and SI integrations? Link to current sheet: https://go/redwood/qbr-boards
martina: On marketplace — GCP/AWS tiles updated. Recommend moving 2 partners from Tier B -> A based on ARR threshold and activation signals. Notes left in sheet.
priya: MDF ask: total incremental request = `50000` across 3 partners. See table I pasted into the sheet:
```
partner,channel,requested_mdf,notes
Nimbus Cloud,marketplace,20000,POC rebate & listing credits
Accel SI,si,15000,enablement + demo credits
CoreHW,hw,15000,co-marketing + booth support
```
sam: SI integrations status: Accel SI is green for core integration; DeltaSI still pending SOW (ETA Wed). I also flagged DeltaSI for engineering onboarding support.
ops-bot: Reminder: QBR slides due by 09:00 Thu. Upload to /shared/qbr/deck or run `/deck upload` in #release-war-room.
josh: I'll own the HW partner slot and the co-marketing ask. @clare can you own the SI demo / live run?
clare: Yes — I can take the SI demo. Need a 15-min handoff with Sam today, preferably 3pm PT.
martina: Also propose we surface "activation rate" (7d DAU/MAU on trial listings) on slide 3 — more predictive than ARR for marketplace cohort.
alex: Good call. Priya, can you add activation rate to the scorecard and roll up MDF column per partner row?
priya: Will do — pushing update in 20m, will add a notes column with the one-liner justification.
alex: Action items: Priya update sheet; Josh prep HW talking points + 1-slide ROI; Clare coordinate SI demo w/ Sam; Martina update tier nominations & activation metric. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
sam: Noted — booking 15m w/ Clare and following up on DeltaSI SOW.
alex: If anyone needs MDF justification phrasing, use: "Co-funded MDF to accelerate certified listings and drive 6–9 month ARR expansion." Paste into the sheet notes.
